## OtpDomainError class

OTP Domain Error Class

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class OtpDomainError extends OtpError 
```
**Extends:** [OtpError](./auth-errors.otperror.md)

## Remarks

Represents expected business logic errors that occur during normal OTP operations. These errors are user-facing and typically result from invalid OTP codes, expired tokens, or other user-related issues.

Domain errors use 'warn' log level as they are expected and don't indicate system problems.

## Example


```typescript
// User enters wrong OTP code
throw new OtpDomainError(OtpDomainErrorCodes.OTP_INVALID);

// OTP code has expired
throw new OtpDomainError(OtpDomainErrorCodes.OTP_EXPIRED);
```
